notifications.subject: New Speakers + Sessions | ISC2 Spotlight: Cloud Security
notifications.snippet: ISC2 Spotlight: Cloud Security（4月28-29日）にセッション追加。「Securing Data in the Age of AI with DSPM」（Netwrix）と「Converging Cloud Security into the Modern SOC」（Palo Alto Networks）が新たに加わる。CPE 5.5単位取得可。

notifications.subject: Move Beyond the CISSP: New ISSAP Enhanced Online Training for Architects in APAC
